title: Detecting HTTP Status Code Misuses in REST APIs via Static and Dynamic Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.12770v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: REST APIs are widely used on the web for client-server communications. As REST is based on HTTP, server responses contain status codes to indicate the outcome of requests (e.g., 200 OK for a success and 404 Not Found for an unavailable resource). While HTTP status codes are standardized, their semantics are not enforced in REST, leading to many misuses in practice (e.g., using 500 Internal Server Error to describe a client error). Such misuses may have nefarious consequences, such as reducing interoperability, misleading API clients, or causing false positives in testing tools. In this paper, we present a combined static and dynamic analysis approach for detecting HTTP status code misuses in REST APIs. We first study 2,625 real-world REST API specifications to identify relevant status codes and derive a set of 30 usage rules based on HTTP standards and REST API principles. We then implement tools to identify such rule violations in OpenA

translated_abstract: REST API在网络中被广泛用于客户端-服务器通信。由于REST基于HTTP，服务器响应中包含状态码以指示请求的结果（例如，200 OK表示成功，404 Not Found表示资源不可用）。尽管HTTP状态码已经标准化，但它们的语义在REST中并未被强制执行，导致实践中出现许多误用情况（例如，使用500 Internal Server Error来描述客户端错误）。这类误用可能带来严重后果，例如降低互操作性、误导API客户端，或在测试工具中造成误报。在本文中，我们提出了一种结合静态与动态分析的方法来检测REST API中的HTTP状态码误用。我们首先研究了2,625个真实世界的REST API规范，以识别相关状态码，并基于HTTP标准和REST API原则推导出一套包含30条使用规则的规则集。然后我们实现了工具来识别OpenA（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合静态与动态分析的方法，通过研究2,625个真实REST API规范并基于HTTP标准与REST原则推导出30条状态码使用规则，从而自动检测REST API中HTTP状态码的误用。
